title: Hospital Funding & Park Budget Decisions
summary:
• **Hospital Funding Request** – Citizens petitioned the city council to approve increased funding for the local hospital

• **Park and Cemetery Funds Established** – The council passed ordinances to create dedicated funds for both park development and cemetery maintenance

• **Meat Market Refund Approved** – Excelsior Meat Market was granted a refund related to pound fees

• **Tax Assessment & Fine Appeals Denied** – The council rejected petitions to reduce property assessments and remit fines, maintaining existing tax obligations
